newsitem.title: BULGARIA: SOCCER-BULGARIANS RALLY AGAINST FOOTBALL CHIEFS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BULGARIANS RALLY AGAINST FOOTBALL CHIEFS.

text.p: More than 300 soccer fans from a town in western Bulgaria protested outside the national soccer union headquarters in Sofia on Thursday demanding the resignation of the union chiefs.
Shouting "Resign" and "Crooks", young players from third division soccer club Marek in the town of Dupnitsa accused the directors of the Bulgarian Football Union (BFU) of corruption.

The protesters complained of biased refereeing at a recent home game but the protest also had political overtones. The head of the football union, Ivan Slavkov, is the son-in-law of former communist leader Todor Zhivkov.
